n1.speaker: ryan
n1.text: Alright? Mum says you came to England this year. What was your first week like?

translations.fa: چطوری؟ مامان میگه امسال اومدی انگلیس. هفتهٔ اولت چطور بود؟

branches.suggestion: It was strange! Everything was new.
branches.suggestionFa: عجیب بود! همه چی جدید بود.

branches.suggestion: The food, the weather, and driving on the left!
branches.suggestionFa: غذا، هوا، و رانندگی از سمت چپ!

branches.suggestion: Everything. The buses, the shops, the money!

recasts.echo: On the left? Yeah, it's weird.
recasts.betterFa: مردم از سمت چپ رانندگی می‌کنند.

n3.speaker: ryan
n3.text: Ha, yeah. Did you get lost? I got lost in Westfield once. For two hours.

translations.fa: ها، آره. گم شدی؟ من یه بار تو وست‌فیلد گم شدم. دو ساعت.

branches.suggestion: Yes! I took the wrong bus on my first day.
branches.suggestionFa: آره! روز اول اتوبوس اشتباه سوار شدم.

branches.suggestion: No, I used the map on my phone.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، از نقشهٔ گوشیم استفاده کردم.

n4.speaker: ryan
n4.text: The wrong bus! Did you tell Dad? He'll say it was the 38. It's always the 38.

translations.fa: اتوبوس اشتباه! به بابا گفتی؟ میگه ۳۸ بوده. همیشه ۳۸ه.

branches.suggestion: It wasn't the 38. It was the 55!

n5.speaker: ryan
n5.text: Smart. What did you eat that first week? Please say not just beans on toast.

translations.fa: زرنگ. اون هفتهٔ اول چی خوردی؟ تو رو خدا نگو فقط لوبیا با نون تست.

branches.suggestion: I ate fish and chips. It was great!
branches.suggestionFa: ماهی و سیب‌زمینی خوردم. عالی بود!

branches.suggestion: I cooked rice every day. I didn't know the shops.
branches.suggestionFa: هر روز برنج پختم. مغازه‌ها را نمی‌شناختم.

cultureNote.en: Fish and chips is a classic British takeaway, often eaten on Fridays.
cultureNote.fa: ماهی و سیب‌زمینی غذای بیرون‌بر کلاسیک بریتانیاست.

n6.speaker: ryan
n6.text: Respect. What was the weirdest thing?

translations.fa: دمت گرم. عجیب‌ترین چیز چی بود؟

branches.suggestion: Everyone queues. Even at the bus stop!
branches.suggestionFa: همه صف وایمیستن. حتی تو ایستگاه اتوبوس!

cultureNote.en: Queuing is very important in Britain. Pushing in is very rude.
cultureNote.fa: صف ایستادن در بریتانیا خیلی مهم است.

n7.speaker: ryan
n7.text: Sorry about that. Ha! See, I did it. Was anyone nice to you?

translations.fa: ببخشید بابتش. ها! دیدی، منم گفتم. کسی باهات مهربون بود؟

branches.suggestion: Your mum and dad. They invited me for tea.
branches.suggestionFa: مامان و بابات. منو برای عصرونه دعوت کردن.

branches.suggestion: Nicola gave me a drawing. It was a cat!
branches.suggestionFa: نیکولا یه نقاشی بهم داد. یه گربه بود!

n8.speaker: ryan
n8.text: A cat? That was you, mate. She draws everyone as a cat. Anyway — welcome to Hackney!

translations.fa: گربه؟ اون تو بودی رفیق. همه را گربه می‌کشه. به هر حال — به هاکنی خوش اومدی!
